values: Open the community map and inspect public report cards
Staging has submitted, under-review, and verified sample reports.
Open the app in guest, user, responder, and admin sessions; inspect the same public reports.
Map and public cards load for each role; report status and generalized location are visible.
Validate required fields, District 5 location, consent, and photo limits
Use separate synthetic reports; have valid and invalid locations available.
Open Report an issue; try missing required fields and consent; select an in-area location; attach allowed photos and try one over the role-specific size limit.

Invalid submissions are blocked with clear feedback; valid submissions preserve category, issue type, observation time, consent, and attachments. Guest photos are limited to 2.5 MB each; signed-in uploads to 5 MB each; maximum five photos.
Check draft recovery, offline queue, keyboard access, and phone layout
Use a supported browser; use staging/demo data only.
Save a draft and resume it; queue a report offline then reconnect; tab through the page; open the form at 390 px width.
Draft values restore; queued submission resumes when online; skip link and keyboard flow work; form fits the phone viewport.
Submit a report while signed out and capture the tracking code
Guest tracking endpoint configured with stable GUEST_TRACKING_SECRET; guest-report migration/API available.
Sign out or use a private window; enter report details, location, consent, optional email; submit; save the code.
Report is accepted once; confirmation provides a usable tracking code; optional email is not required.
Retrieve report history with valid code and reject invalid code
Have a guest tracking code and an invalid/random code.
Open guest tracking; look up the valid code, then try the invalid code.
Valid code returns only that report's history; invalid code returns a generic failure and does not reveal another report.
Confirm a resolved report was fixed or request follow-up
Seed or progress a guest report to Resolved; guest feedback migration applied.
Use its tracking code; choose fixed or follow-up and submit.
Feedback is saved to the correct report and appears in its timeline; follow-up notifies staff.
Confirm that an open community issue is still present
Have an open non-private community report.
Open the public report and submit the still-present confirmation.
Confirmation creates a timeline event and alerts staff without exposing reporter contact details.
Exercise guest intake honeypot, minimum-time, and rate-limit guards
Use isolated staging with API rate-limit migration; coordinate request limits.
Submit controlled requests with honeypot populated, too-fast completion, and repeated attempts.
Unsafe requests are rejected or throttled; no report is created; response does not disclose secrets or internal details.
Sign up or sign in and verify own pending report history
Resident test account and email policy configured; one owned pending report.
Sign in; open own reports; compare report details and status with the seeded record.
User sees own pending report history and profile controls; session persists as expected.
Follow a report and receive status or assignment notifications
Notification migration applied; user follows a report; trigger a safe status or assignment change.
Follow the report; trigger the event as staff; refresh or open notification inbox.
Notification is scoped to the recipient, links to the right report, and read state updates.
Exchange comment, information request, reply, and up to three photos
Report communication migration applied; signed-in reporter and authorized staff test accounts.
Have staff request information; reply as reporter with text and up to three photos; inspect timeline.
Reporter can access their report conversation; messages and attachments appear chronologically; unauthorized users cannot read it.
Check own-photo access and deny another user's private report/photo access
Two resident accounts with separate reports and private photos.
Open own report and photo; attempt to access the second user's report/photo in a non-owner session.
Owner can access permitted own content; other resident is denied; public map does not expose private photo paths or extra information.
Confirm resident cannot access staff desk or elevate own role
Resident account; admin-only test endpoint available in staging.
Inspect navigation; attempt direct staff route and unauthorized role/admin action.
Staff controls and staff data remain unavailable; server/database rejects unauthorized operations.
Confirm reporter can respond to resolution and request follow-up
Open the report; confirm fixed or request follow-up; inspect staff/admin view.
Feedback is recorded against the report; an admin can see and act on the follow-up.
Open staff desk and inspect assigned-work queue
Invited responder account; one directly assigned and one team-assigned task.
Sign in; open Staff desk and Response queue; inspect report details and private photos.
Responder can review staff report details and private photos; queue includes applicable direct/team assignments.
Allow assigned work and deny unassigned or other-responder updates
Prepare assigned, team-assigned, unassigned, and another responder's report.
Open each report; attempt to change status or submit work where not assigned.
Responder can work only on directly or team-assigned tasks; other updates are rejected by server/database rules.
Start assigned task and submit resolution notes with after-photos
Assigned verified report; photo bucket configured.
Start work; add response notes and resolution photos; submit for admin review.
Report moves through In progress to Awaiting verification; notes and private after-photos are stored; admin review is pending.
Verify team members can access and complete team-assigned work
Teams migration applied; responder is an active member of the assigned team.
Open a team-assigned report; start work and submit resolution.
Authorized team member can complete the task; a non-member responder is denied.
Reply to reporter information request or comment on assigned report
Report communication migration applied; assigned report with conversation.
Open conversation; reply with text and an allowed photo; inspect timeline and reporter view.
Responder can communicate on assigned work; reporter receives the message; other reports remain inaccessible.
Confirm responder cannot manage teams, verify reports, assign work, or review resolutions
Responder account and eligible test records.
Inspect staff navigation and attempt direct admin-only actions on staging.
Admin-only controls are absent and protected actions are rejected by server/database authorization.
Review dashboard metrics, queue search, filters, and pagination
Admin account; diverse sample reports across statuses, urgency, categories, and barangays.
Open dashboard and Response desk; search by title/ID; apply filters; move through queue pages.
Metrics and charts load; search/filter results match criteria; paging returns the next set without duplicates or omissions.
Verify, request information, reject, and mark duplicate reports
Seed separate Submitted/Under review reports and a duplicate candidate.
Use each verification action with notes where available; inspect status and timeline.
Each action sets the correct status, notes, verifier, and timestamp; duplicate links to the source report; reporter receives appropriate notice.
Correct category or urgency and record verification note
Pending report with known incorrect category/urgency.
Edit the values in verification; save with a note.
Corrected values persist; note and verifier are recorded; analytics and queue reflect the update.
Assign verified report to responder/team with priority, due date, and instructions
Verified report; responder/team setup complete; team migration applied for team assignment.
Assign directly, to a team, and to both in separate records; set priority, due date, and instructions.
Assignments persist; responder/team workload updates; assignees are notified; due date and instructions are visible to assignee.
Approve, reject, return for action, close, and reopen a resolution
Reports in Awaiting verification, Resolved, and eligible closed states.
Use each review action with a review note; request follow-up/reopen a persistent issue.
Each action updates status and review metadata, appears in the timeline, and sends the appropriate recipient notification.
Create/manage team and invite a responder
Teams migration applied; service role key configured server-side; test mailbox available.
Create team and choose members; invite responder; accept invite and sign in.
Team membership is saved; invite assigns responder role server-side; invitation flow completes without exposing service key.
Change response thresholds and process overdue reports
Response settings migration applied; controlled overdue fixtures; cron/manual processing configured.
Set standard and high-urgency thresholds; run a manual check or staging schedule; inspect escalation and notification records.
Configured thresholds drive overdue behavior; escalation stages are recorded once; recipients and delivery outcomes are correct.
Review recurring hotspot and schedule/complete an inspection
Recurrence migration applied; at least three qualifying same-category reports within 350 m and 90 days.
Open hotspot; schedule team inspection with due date; complete it as admin or assigned team.
Hotspot criteria are correct; task is assigned and due-dated; completion is recorded in the workflow.
Generate date-range summary and export CSV/PDF
Reports across categories, barangays, statuses, and dates; browser print available.
Generate daily/weekly/monthly/custom summary; export CSV; export PDF through print dialog.
Summary filters match selected range; CSV opens with expected fields; PDF/print output is readable and complete.
Complete guest report through admin review and responder resolution
Guest code, admin, responder, and staging report fixture; notification features enabled if in scope.
Guest submits; admin verifies and assigns; responder resolves; admin approves; guest tracks and confirms outcome.
Each role sees only its permitted actions; status, assignment, timeline, notifications, and final guest feedback remain consistent.
Use the agreed UAT site and synthetic/non-sensitive test details.
Choose a category and issue type; provide description, observed time, location, and required visibility consent; submit.
Report is accepted with the information needed by staff; confirmation is understandable; location is within the supported District 5 area.
Review a submitted report on the community map
At least one submitted or under-review UAT report.
Open the map and report card from a separate session.
Community can understand the issue and approximate area; private contact details, additional info, and private photo paths are not shown.
Report an issue without signing in
Guest reporting enabled; optional email may be used.
Complete the report form and submit as a guest.
Guest can report without creating an account and receives clear confirmation.
Use the tracking code to follow progress
A guest report and its tracking code.
Enter the code in guest tracking and review the report history.
Guest can find the correct report and understand its current status and timeline.
Tell staff whether a resolved issue was fixed
Use the tracking code; confirm fixed or ask for follow-up.
Feedback is easy to submit and is visible to staff for action.
Check what the public can see about reports
Public report with optional guest email and extra context.
View the report on the community map without signing in.
Public view gives useful community information while keeping email and extra context private.
Sign in and submit a report
Sign in; submit a report with location, details, consent, and optional photos.
User can submit and later find the report in their own history.
Follow a report and check status/assignment updates
User account; report available to follow; notifications enabled.
Follow a report; have staff change status or assignment; open the notification inbox.
Updates are relevant, understandable, and linked to the right report.
Respond to a request for more information
User's report has an information request.
Open the conversation; reply with requested details and, if useful, photos.
User can provide context and see the exchange in the report timeline.
Confirm whether the reported issue was resolved
User feedback is recorded and staff can follow up when needed.
Find a task assigned directly or through a team
Responder account with direct and team assignments.
Open Staff desk and Response queue; review task details, location, and instructions.
Responder can find the work they are responsible for and has enough information to act.
Start work and submit a resolution
Assigned verified report; photos available if desired.
Start the task; complete the work; submit resolution notes and after-photos.
Task status shows work in progress and then waiting for admin review; notes/photos support the outcome.
Respond to reporter or staff information in the conversation
Read the conversation and send a concise update or reply.
Relevant participants can follow the exchange and the timeline stays clear.
Check that only assigned work can be changed
One assigned report and one report assigned elsewhere.
Open both records and try to take action.
Responder can act on assigned work and is prevented from changing other work.
Use the dashboard to understand current workload
Admin account and realistic UAT sample data.
Review totals, pending/high urgency work, trends, response times, and team workload.
Dashboard gives a clear and consistent picture of report volume and work needing attention.
Decide whether a report is valid, needs information, rejected, or duplicate
Reports prepared for each review outcome.
Open each report; record a verification note; apply the appropriate action.
Admin can make and explain review decisions; report status and reporter-facing updates are clear.
Send verified work to the right responder or team
Set assignee/team, priority, due date, and instructions.
Assignee receives the task and can understand its priority, deadline, and expected work.
Review responder-submitted work and choose the next step
Review notes/photos; approve, send back, reject, or close as appropriate.
Admin can verify completion or explain what more is needed; reporter and responder see the resulting status.
Organize teams and invite a responder
Admin account; invitations and team features configured.
Create/manage a team; invite a responder; confirm the responder can sign in and receive assigned work.
Admin can maintain the operational team and new responder can begin work.
Set response deadlines and check overdue work
Admin settings and deadline processing configured.
Review or adjust standard/high-urgency thresholds; run a check; review resulting alerts.
Deadlines are understandable and overdue work is surfaced to the right staff.
Review trends, export a summary, and plan a recurring inspection
Summary and recurrence features enabled; qualifying sample reports.
Generate a period summary; export it; review hotspot and schedule an inspection when appropriate.
Summary is suitable for operational review; recurring issue is visible; inspection has an owner and due date.
Follow a report from community submission to resident feedback
Guest or user, admin, and responder accounts; notifications in scope.
Submit as guest/user; admin verifies and assigns; responder completes; admin reviews; reporter tracks and responds.
The end-to-end process is understandable, each handoff reaches the next role, and the final outcome is visible to the reporter.
